create.name: Dr. Jennifer Lisa Vest
create.bio:
Dr. Jennifer Lisa Vest is an Afro-Indigenous intuitive, Akashic records reader, medium and ceremonialist based in Berkeley, California, who writes and teaches as "the Ethical Psychic". She holds a PhD in Indigenous philosophy from the University of California, Berkeley, an MA in history from Howard University and a BA in physics from Hampshire College, and taught philosophy at two universities before turning to spiritual teaching full time. She trained in Native American sweat lodge ceremony, African American Hoodoo, Caribbean spiritual healing and Spiritualism, and is a firekeeper, a Usui Reiki Master and a certified QHHT past-life regression practitioner.

She founded Metatron's Academy of Spirit and Science, an online school with self-paced courses on auras, the Akashic records and psychic development, and teaches regularly on The Shift Network. Her book The Ethical Psychic is a beginner's guide to working with intuitive gifts with integrity, and Sovereign Wisdom, from her academic career, proposes ways to build Native American philosophy from Indigenous cultures. On YouTube she talks about spirit guides, ancestors, mediumship and the Akashic records, alongside psychic commentary on current events.

books.title: The Ethical Psychic: A Beginner's Guide to Healing with Integrity, Avoiding Unethical Encounters, and Using Your Gifts for Good
books.author: Jennifer Lisa Vest
books.description: A beginner's guide for people developing psychic and intuitive gifts, centred on working with integrity. It covers how to recognise and avoid unethical encounters, with practitioners or in spirit, and how to use one's gifts for good.

books.title: Sovereign Wisdom: Generating Native American Philosophy from Indigenous Cultures
books.author: Jennifer Lisa Vest
books.description: An academic book, published in Peter Lang's Critical Indigenous and American Indian Studies series, that proposes a method for building Native American philosophy as a field. It works from themes that recur across Indigenous North American cultures.

courses.title: Access Your Akashic Records: A Journey into Cosmic Wisdom
courses.description: A self-paced online course in 34 lessons on what the Akashic records are and how to access them. It combines lectures, guided meditations and exercises aimed at intuition, life purpose and personal growth.

courses.title: All About Auras: Subtle Energy Bodies and How to Perceive Them
courses.description: A self-paced beginners' course in three sections on what auras are, how they are used and how to perceive them. Short video lessons are followed by practical exercises.

courses.title: Strategic Psychic
courses.description: A self-paced course in 24 lessons on the basics of psychic development and four forms of intuitive perception. It covers protection, building gifts into daily life and improving the accuracy of readings.
